name: Sticky Webbing
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
description: Fine, sticky threads of spiders' silk are strung across their lair.
disable: DC 15 Survival or DC 15 Thievery to carefully remove the strands.

offensiveAbilities.name: Capturing Strands
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature that isn't a spider moves into the sticky webbing

Effect The sticky webbing covers the triggering creature's body. The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 19 Reflex Saving Throw save or is Clumsy 1 until a ◆◆ maneuver is performed to clean off the sticky webbing.
